description: Analysis code and derived result tables for a two-sample cis-pQTL Mendelian randomization and colocalization study of circulating plasma proteins and the urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio, with independent replication in UKB-PPP and EBI pQTL panels. All input summary statistics are public; no individual-level data were used.
